nodes.label: Announcement Deduplication Rule
nodes.rationale: Repeated reminders of the same task must be extracted once to avoid duplicate items.

nodes.label: Datetime Parameters Extraction (no calendar math)
nodes.rationale: Model only extracts raw date/time parameters; actual calendar math is left to the backend to avoid date-calculation errors.

nodes.label: Balance Rule (tie-breaker)
nodes.rationale: Topic lengths balanced only as a tie-breaker; semantic boundaries always win.

nodes.label: Content Filtering Rule (15-sentence threshold)
nodes.rationale: Short filler is absorbed into neighbors to keep coverage continuous without polluting keywords.

nodes.label: Continuity Rule (gapless SID coverage)
nodes.rationale: Every transcript sentence must belong to exactly one topic so downstream SID ranges stay continuous.

nodes.rationale: Style is chosen ahead of time so each student's lecture collection stays visually varied.

nodes.label: The Uncovered self-study list
nodes.rationale: Derived strictly from omissions named in card_mapping_strategy; skipped when nothing was omitted.

nodes.label: Bundle observations by hook, not topic
nodes.norm_label: bundle observations by hook, not topic

nodes.label: Evidence threshold for traits
nodes.rationale: A wrong profile item hurts more than a missing one, so traits need stated or ~3 independent observations.

nodes.label: Record, never generalize (hook element)
nodes.rationale: Observer records raw observations with a hook; only the Consolidator generalizes across conversations.

nodes.label: Study conversations rarely yield observations
nodes.rationale: Coursework steps say nothing about who the student is; most study sessions should produce zero observations.

nodes.norm_label: seed fun fact idea schema (named_instance, concrete_detail, search_queries)

nodes.label: Personalization Strategy (profile match vs universal fallback)
nodes.norm_label: personalization strategy (profile match vs universal fallback)
nodes.rationale: Profile connection prioritized only when natural; forced stretches are abandoned.

nodes.label: Sense Fidelity Rule
nodes.rationale: Candidates must share the real mechanism from concept_intro_line, not a pun on the keyword.

nodes.label: High-energy TA voice with everyday words
nodes.norm_label: high-energy ta voice with everyday words
nodes.rationale: Readers may be first-year students; plain words and openly shown excitement make the story land.

nodes.label: Mobile-first 5-second glanceability rule
nodes.rationale: Figures focus on 3-5 core stages for smartphone widths 360-420px to avoid cognitive overload.

nodes.label: Connected Reasoning rule
nodes.rationale: Sentences must state how they connect instead of splitting into disconnected fragments.

nodes.label: No Meta-Language rule
nodes.rationale: Notes must read as a self-contained textbook, never describing the classroom event.

nodes.norm_label: removal repair workflow (survey, repair clusters, integrate pending additions)

nodes.label: lefture-email-worker (Cloudflare Email Sending relay)
nodes.rationale: Centralizes transactional mail from GCP backend via Cloudflare send_email binding instead of external SaaS like Resend.

nodes.label: Build on current cover rule
nodes.rationale: The cover carries facts said once long ago; it is grown rather than rewritten, changing points only for removed or newer items.
